description: Comprehensive inventory of frontend_new features, pages, components, API integration, services, models and utilities. Fully integrated with PropDirect Backend API.

framework.http_client: axios with interceptors for auth and error handling

api_integration.response_interceptor: Handles 401 errors by clearing auth and redirecting to /login

auth.register: POST /auth/register - Create new user with validation
auth.send_otp: POST /auth/send-otp - Send OTP to email or phone
auth.verify_otp: POST /auth/verify-otp - Verify OTP and mark user verified

properties.list_search: GET /properties - Search with filters (city, type, price, bedrooms, etc)
properties.get_by_id: GET /properties/{id} - Get property details and increment views
properties.create: POST /properties - Create new property (owner only, auto-generates title)
properties.delete: DELETE /properties/{id} - Delete property and remove images (owner only)
properties.bulk_delete: DELETE /properties/bulk - Bulk delete multiple properties (owner only)
properties.radius_search: POST /properties/radius-search - Search via Haversine formula with lat/lng/radius
properties.debug_count: GET /properties/debug/count - Get stats and sample cities (debug only)

users.get_profile: GET /users/me - Get current authenticated user profile
users.delete_account: DELETE /users/me - Delete user and associated images
users.get_my_properties: GET /users/my-properties - List properties owned by current user

inquiries.create: POST /inquiries - Create inquiry for property (prevents owner and duplicates)
inquiries.get_my_inquiries: GET /inquiries/my-inquiries - List inquiries made by user
inquiries.get_property_inquiries: GET /inquiries/property-inquiries - List inquiries on user's properties
inquiries.update: PUT /inquiries/{id} - Update inquiry (property owner can update inquiries on their properties)

wishlist.get_wishlist: GET /wishlist - Get wishlist items with property details
wishlist.check_status: GET /wishlist/check/{propertyId} - Check if property is favorited

notifications.list: GET /notifications - Get latest 20 notifications with unread count
notifications.mark_read: PUT /notifications/{id}/read - Mark single notification as read
notifications.mark_all_read: PUT /notifications/mark-all-read - Mark all notifications as read

contacts.get_my_contacts: GET /contacts/my-contacts - Get unique owners from user's inquiries

timeline.get_activities: GET /timeline/activities - Build user activity timeline from inquiries and listings

agreements.get_my_agreements: GET /agreements/my-agreements - Fetch rental agreements for tenant

rewards.get_points: GET /rewards/points - Compute user points from activities (properties, inquiries)

chatbot.send_message: POST /chatbot/chat - Rule-based chatbot for common queries

authentication_and_security.login_flow: POST /auth/login -> receive access_token -> store in localStorage -> add Bearer header to all requests
authentication_and_security.register_flow: POST /auth/register -> validate email & phone uniqueness -> create user -> auto login or redirect to login
authentication_and_security.logout: Clear localStorage token/user -> call POST /auth/logout (optional) -> redirect to home

interceptors.request: Adds 'Authorization: Bearer {token}' header if token exists
interceptors.response: On 401 error: clear auth, redirect to /login

authentication_and_security.security_notes: Backend uses bcrypt for password hashing, JWT for tokens, timing attack mitigation on login

hooks.useMapFilters.ts: Manages map filter state and controls
hooks.useSavedSearches.ts: Persists and retrieves saved search queries

utils.api_client.ts: Axios instance with all service modules (propertyAPI, authAPI, userAPI, etc)
utils.imageUrl.ts: Helpers for image URL construction and validation
utils.mapIcons.ts: Map marker icons and legend utilities
utils.sanitization: Input sanitization via DOMPurify (if installed) or basic trimming

hooks_and_utilities.types: src/types/index.ts - TypeScript interfaces for User, Property, Inquiry, Notification, Chat, etc

user_management: User registration with email & phone validation
Login via OAuth2 form with JWT token response
Account deletion with cascading image cleanup
property_listings: Bulk delete with image path validation
Search with filters: city, type, listing_type, price range, bedrooms, furnished, sort, pagination
View count increment per property access
geospatial_search: Radius search using Haversine formula with bounding box pre-filter
Geofence polygon search with polygon and bounding box
inquiries: Create inquiry for property (prevents owner self-inquiry and duplicates)
List inquiries received on user's properties
Update inquiries (property owners can update inquiries on their properties)
Delete inquiries (user can delete own inquiries)
wishlist_favorites: View full wishlist with property details
Check if specific property is favorited
notifications: Mark all unread notifications as read
social_and_engagement: Derive contacts list from inquiries (unique owners contacted)
gamification: User points calculation from properties and inquiries
debugging_and_testing: Stats and city count endpoint (debug only)

data_models_available.user: User (id, email, phone, full_name, verified, created_at, updated_at, etc)
data_models_available.property: Property (id, owner_id, title, description, city, lat, lng, price, bedrooms, furnished, listing_type, views, created_at, updated_at, images relation)
data_models_available.inquiry: Inquiry (id, user_id, property_id, message, status, created_at, updated_at)
data_models_available.otp: OTP (id, user_id, code, verified, created_at, expires_at)

file_handling.upload_directory: Mounted as /static in backend; configured via config.upload_dir
file_handling.file_security: secure_file_path validation for deletion to prevent directory traversal
file_handling.cascade_deletion: User and property deletion removes associated images from filesystem

development_notes.otp_behavior: OTP returned/printed in dev when email not configured; proper SMTP in production
development_notes.referrals_rewards: Referral stats and some reward endpoints are stub implementations pending business logic
development_notes.chatbot: Simple keyword matching; expandable for LLM integration
development_notes.security_hardening: Further production hardening recommended beyond current JWT + bcrypt + timing attack mitigation
development_notes.sanitization: Optional DOMPurify integration; basic trimming fallback

testing.framework: Jest/React Testing Library for frontend; pytest for backend
testing.coverage: Auth, properties, inquiries, OTP, permissions, geospatial, wishlist, notifications

deployment_and_config.backend_env: DATABASE_URL, SECRET_KEY, UPLOAD_DIR, ALLOWED_ORIGINS, EMAIL_CONFIG, TOKEN_EXPIRY
deployment_and_config.docker: Separate Dockerfile for frontend and backend; docker-compose.yml provided
deployment_and_config.production_ready: Bearer token auth, CORS headers, rate limiting, input validation
